summary.text: The story takes place on Mirrodin, the artificial world Karn made, and follows Glissa, Slobad and their friends as they discover why levelers seek to destroy her.
Memnarch, the protector Karn made, is corrupted by Phyrexian oil, renames the plane Mirrodin and abducts beings from other planes, and he becomes obsessed with stealing Glissa's spark.
Glissa and Slobad defeat Memnarch in Mirrodin's Core, and Slobad gives up the spark, triggering the Vanishing that returns the dead and the kidnapped to their homes.
